nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes:
POST {task: '...'} to /webhook/agent-orchestra to kick off a run.
Returns the final summary when the orchestrator finishes.

nodes.name: Pre-flight: Lessons Lookup
nodes.notes:
Surfaces past lessons before the orchestrator starts — lets us log them to the
trace and short-circuit if a critical past failure applies. Non-blocking: continues on error.

nodes.name: Start Orchestra Run
nodes.notes:
Kicks off the native agent_orchestra execution. The orchestrator handles:
 - Spec/Preview, Context Gather, Planner
 - Plan gate (human-in-the-loop)
 - Architect → Test Writer → Coder → Debugger (delegation loop, 5 rounds)
 - Docs Checker, Adversarial Critic, Critic Gate
 - Experiential Logger, Summariser
